text: This report provides the Toronto Investment Board (Board) with the findings and recommendations arising from Aon's Global Equity Strategy Review and Manager Search. The study evaluates alternative global equity strategy styles, their suitability within the Fund's portfolio, and the investment managers identified by Aon as best positioned to implement each strategy. The report also seeks the Board's endorsement of the recommended strategic approach and approval for Aon to continue its work in support of the manager search and selection process. Aon's analysis and recommendations are provided in Confidential Attachment 1, and the engagement agreement with Aon, including the scope of work and associated consulting fee, is provided in Confidential Attachment 2 for the Board's information.
The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Deferred consideration of this item until the next special meeting of the Toronto Investment Board called by the Chair.
